description: I am on no timeline and not in a rush . There is a fine line between taking action and sitting in stillness #selflove #flexibility #selfcare
transcript: I am on no timeline, and am not at risk of losing anything. Nothing happens for no reason. When you rush, you make a necessary mistake. There is an art form in moving with urgency and also moving with stillness. There's a fine line between both and understanding how to work throughout that allows you to stay in the present moment as well as keep momentum.
